retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style graphic layout featuring a central square of organic, Matisse-like paper cutouts topped by bold horizontal bands of stencil and extended typography.
triggerTerms: stencil display typography with blue header
excludeWhen: modern minimalist digital gradients are requested
delicate script or serif body text is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition framed by a wide white border, containing a central grid of three horizontal zones: a top red extended title, a middle blue band with white stencil lettering, and a large bottom square filled with organic, multi-colored abstract shapes on a yellow ground.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal typographic bands stacked above a square graphic field
Organic, hand-cut shapes contrasting with rigid geometric text blocks
Primary color blocks (red, blue, yellow) creating high-energy visual rhythm
Heavy white border providing a clean frame for the dense internal composition
coreInvariants: Central square graphic field containing abstract organic shapes
Top-heavy typographic hierarchy with distinct color-coded bands
Flat, unshaded color application across all elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The abstract collage occupies the lower 60% of the central square, while typography dominates the upper 40%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright blue horizontal band containing the primary display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the red title to the blue band, settling into the complex rhythmic patterns of the abstract collage.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial white outer margin framing the entire square composition.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primary colors with high value contrast against white and black.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs and condensed stencils
letterConstructionRules: Top line: Ultra-extended, heavy slab serif with minimal counters
Middle line: Condensed stencil-style display face with vertical breaks
Bottom line: Small, monospaced sans-serif for metadata
characterSpecificRedesigns: Stencil gaps in the middle display text are placed at the top and bottom of vertical strokes
Integration of a circular graphic swirl within the middle text line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-wide slab serifs and ultra-narrow stencil serifs.

preserve: Extended width of the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast stencil look of the main title

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Extended Slab Serif (e.g., Microgramma or Eurostile Bold Extended)
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, heavy feel of the top line

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square composition with a wide white border. Inside, place a red horizontal line of text at the top, a solid blue band below it, and a large yellow square at the bottom filled with abstract, organic paper-cut shapes in red, green, and black. Add a thin black bar at the very bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white stencil-style display text centered within the blue band. Add small white monospaced metadata text within the bottom black bar.

verificationChecks: Is the top text line ultra-extended and red?
Does the blue band contain white stencil-style lettering?
Are the collage shapes organic and flat-colored?
Is there a wide white margin around the central square?

adjustableVariables: Width of the blue header band
Thickness of the outer white border
mustRedesign: Exact arrangement of the abstract shapes
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the stencil gaps in the typography are visible.
Verify the red text is significantly wider than it is tall.
Check that the collage shapes do not overlap in a way that creates new colors.
Confirm the overall layout maintains a square aspect ratio within the white frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Extended Slab Serif Header] + [Blue Stencil Band] + [Matisse-style Abstract Collage] + [White Border Frame]
